item.title: Crypto’s Leverage Machine Finds New Life Beyond Bitcoin Bets
item.description: A year after crypto’s historic crash, leveraged trading has yet to regain its old swagger. But the appetite for outsize bets hasn’t disappeared. Increasingly, the machinery that made crypto notorious for speculation is being turned on stocks, commodities and other traditional assets rather than just digital tokens.
item.dc:creator: Sidhartha Shukla
